steps.text: emi-search: open the creative inventory so EMI's sidebar and its search box are up
emi-search: EMI's own config binds focus-search to Ctrl+F and its keyboard mixin claims the chord before JEI's handler sees it, so this is EMI's box, not JEI's
emi-search: type the pinyin of 石头 (shi tou) one character at a time
